title: Deepit Bhatia
text: I am an infectious disease epidemiologist focused on bridging the gaps between theoretical and applied epidemiology. My research explores how disease elimination can be achieved through vaccination in human and livestock diseases. I am a recent PhD graduate in Biology at the Center for Infectious Disease Dynamics at Penn State University.
